name: MOMORDICA BALSAMICA
key_symptoms: Dizzy, contents of head feel lighter; mist before eyes.
guiding_symptoms: Dizzy, contents of head feel lighter; mist before eyes.
head_symptoms: Dizzy, contents of head feel lighter; mist before eyes.
gi_symptoms: Rumbling, griping, colicky pains, starting from back, spreading over abdomen.
urinary_symptoms: Painful and profuse menses; labor-like pains, followed by gushes of blood; pain at small of back coming towards front of pelvis.

source.title: MOMORDICA BALSAMICA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
